calendar_row.eventDescription: One calendar event returned: an earnings report (with EPS estimate, report time, last-year EPS, market cap), a dividend (ex-date, record and payment dates, rate), an IPO (price, shares, deal value, status), or a stock split (ratio, execution date). The first row per run is free so you can validate output.
